name: ppmr-read
why: MRC c15,c2,4 (ARM1176 peripheral port remap) does not exist on ARM11 MPCore -> mov r3,#0

name: ppmr-write
why: MCR c15,c2,4 in the vector-page reset path -> nop

name: ifar-pabt-user
why: IFAR (c6,c0,2) is absent on MPCore: the handler already did lr -= 4 at 0x800662ac, so fault address = lr (mov r1, lr)

name: ifar-pabt-kernel
why: IFAR (c6,c0,2) is absent on MPCore: fault address = lr after the entry lr -= 4 (mov r5, lr)

name: actlr-write
why: ARM1176 ACTLR bits mean different things on MPCore (bit5 = SMP): ignore writes

name: uart-init
why: S5L UART init would touch MMIO that does not exist on the 3DS: bx lr

name: uart-baud
why: S5L UART baud setup: bx lr

name: uart-tx-ready
why: S5L UART transmit-ready: always ready (mov r0,#4; bx lr)

name: uart-tx-data
why: S5L UART transmit: ldr pc,=shim_putc (log ring read by the ARM9)

name: uart-rx-ready
why: S5L UART receive-ready: never (mov r0,#0; bx lr)

name: uart-rx-data
why: S5L UART receive: mov r0,#0; bx lr

name: timer-get-abstime
why: cpu_data timer hook: 64-bit time base from the MPCore watchdog (S5L timer regs don't exist)

name: timer-get-decrementer
why: cpu_data timer hook: ticks left = MPCore private timer counter

name: timer-set-decrementer
why: cpu_data timer hook: arm the MPCore private timer (GIC IRQ 29)

name: irq-entry
why: IRQ entry -> shim: GIC ack; timer IRQ re-enters the kernel's FIQ handler (r9_fiq)

name: mdevstrategy
why: memdev (md0) strategy -> shim: block I/O served by the ARM9 from sd:/ios3ds/rootfs.hfs (Thumb: ldr r3,[pc]; bx r3)

name: rtc-wait-0s
why: AppleARMPE::getGMTTimeOfDay waits 30 s for an RTC that doesn't exist yet (PMU/MCU driver TODO): timeout 0

name: iortc-wait-0s
why: IOKitInitializeTime (bsd_init, 0x8024a53e) waits 30 s for resourceMatching("IORTC") before clock_initialize_calendar; nothing publishes IORTC yet (no RTC driver): timeout 0 (same as rtc-wait-0s, which proved 0 = no wait)

name: clcd-sync-swap
why: AppleM2CLCD swap_begin: take the debug-flag-0x10 path (swap-done signalled synchronously, no frame IRQ needed)
